title: add downgrade guard + backup/restore + version-pinning for upgrade/rollback tooling
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Customers running Private (VPC/on-prem) reported upgrade failures when attempting rollbacks during schema-incompatible upgrades. This PR implements a coordinated upgrade/rollback safety net: version pinning for operator components, a transactional backup/restore workflow for postgres + object store snapshots, and explicit downgrade guards around schema migrations. The goal is to make upgrades observable and reversible without leaving clusters in a partially-migrated state. Changes are split into three main areas: 1) installer/helm: chart hooks and pre-upgrade checks, pinned images and component versions, and a job-based backup step that runs before any schema migration; 2) terraform/modules: new outputs and locks to prevent incompatible plan changes, and a flag to opt-in to automatic rollback on failure; 3) tooling/scripts: a small CLI to run a safe restore path and helpers for verifying backup integrity. This description includes a checklist of manual verification steps that CI cannot fully simulate, links to Linear tickets, and a short rollback playbook for operators. Checklist: - [x] Add image version pinning for controller, migrator, and operator - [x] Add helm pre-upgradeJob that performs backup and verifies snapshot - [x] Implement downgrade guard in migration runner (detect attempt to run older schema) - [x] Add terraform plan-time check to block destructive changes to DB resources unless confirmed - [x] Add restore CLI with idempotency checks - [x] Add e2e test that simulates partial migration and triggers rollback Notes: Because some customers run air-gapped installs, backup targets are configurable (S3-compatible endpoints or NFS). The restore path is intentionally conservative: it requires an operator acknowledgement flag to prevent accidental data loss. Related: Linear ENG-8242, ENG-8290; Support ticket SUP-4128. Breaking changes: none for hosted API; private-installer operators should read the release notes and follow the playbook.
commits: pin: version pin controller/operator/migrator images and add CHANGELOG entries
installer: add helm pre-upgrade Job to create DB + object snapshots
migrator: introduce downgrade guard flag and transactional migration wrapper
terraform: add plan-time DB lock check and new outputs for backup metadata
cli: add redwood-installer restore command with verification steps
tests: add e2e scenario for rollback path and fixture updates
review_comments: Miguel Torres: Can we make the pre-upgrade hook idempotent? If helm retries it might re-upload a snapshot and confuse the restore flow.
Asha Patel: Yes — the job now writes a single marker file in the backup location and exits cleanly if the marker exists. Added idempotency test in e2e.
Priya Raman: The migrator guard currently exits with code 1 on downgrade attempts; can we turn that into a clear error message and provide remediation steps in the logs?
Asha Patel: Updated guard to log remediation steps and emit a metrics counter (migration.downgrade_attempts). Added doc fragment to upgrade-playbook.md.
Ethan Cole: Terraform check is helpful but we need an escape hatch for emergency infra ops. Suggest a manual override with an explicit confirmation variable and a security audit log.
Asha Patel: Added terraform var 'force_destructive_db_changes' which requires a non-empty confirmation string and emits an audit entry via a new output that operators must capture.
CI: integration-private-installer failed once due to flaky snapshot upload; re-run succeeded. Added a retry wrapper to the upload step to reduce flakiness.
release_notes: Private Installer: added upgrade safety features — image version pinning, pre-upgrade backups, transactional migrations with downgrade guards, terraform plan-time DB checks, and a restore CLI. Operators: follow docs/upgrade-playbook.md before upgrading. No breaking changes for hosted deployments.
